::: {.software-header}
::: {}
Qploidy2 is designed for large-scale copy-number variation, ploidy, and aneuploidy estimation using genotyping-platform data. Its workflow includes methods based on allele-ratio information and Hidden Markov Models.

<div class="meta-row"><span class="pill">R package</span><span class="pill">Ploidy + CNV</span><span class="pill">HMM</span></div>
:::
<img class="software-logo" src="../assets/software-qploidy2.png" alt="Qploidy2 logo">
:::

## Start here

```r
# Development version
remotes::install_github("Breeding-Insight/Qploidy2")
```

[Source code](https://github.com/Breeding-Insight/Qploidy2){.btn-bi-primary}
[Alfalfa tutorial](https://breeding-insight.github.io/Qploidy2/Qploidy_alfalfa_tutorial.html){.btn-bi-secondary}

## Good fit for

- Ploidy estimation
- Aneuploidy detection
- Large-scale copy-number analysis from marker data
